Subject: Supplier intake: onboarding forms + PO requirement question

Hi David / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're ready to move forward on the pilot but have a quick question about billing: our finance team usually requires a PO for any vendor charges. Given this is a 3-month pilot (estimated spend ~ $6k/month), can Redwood accept invoices without a PO or do we need to create one before the first charge?

Attached are the completed intake forms and our W-9. If a PO is required, please confirm the correct billing contact and whether there is a minimum threshold to qualify for a temporary exemption.

Attachments: nimble_onboarding_forms.zip (zip), vendor_w9.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate any guidance — we aim to start the pilot the week of April 22.

Best,
Melissa Chen
NimbleWorks — Operations
onboarding@nimbleworks.com

Subject: Re: Supplier intake: onboarding forms + PO requirement question

Thanks Melissa — received the forms and W-9, that's helpful. Quick note to loop in Procurement (Karthik) and Finance (Marissa) to confirm the billing path.

Internal note / ask: we're proposing a temporary no-PO authorization for this pilot under the following constraints:
- Spend cap: $10,000/month aggregated across accounts
- Duration: 90 days from go-live
- Invoicing: NimbleWorks to submit consolidated invoices weekly and include Redwood's project code (NW-PILOT-045)
- Evidence: retain W-9 and onboarding form on file; provide invoice + payment proof within 30 days of invoice

If Procurement/Finance agree, we'll provide a signed temporary agreement and enable the account so Nimble can start April 22. If a PO is required, please advise the billing contact and lead time to obtain one.

Attachment: vendor-risk-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet) — internal intake of risk and suggested controls.

Thanks,
David Kim

Copying the thread for the record. After quick review with Finance, Procurement will approve a limited temporary no-PO path with the following firm conditions:

1) Authorization window: 90 days starting on the first invoice date.
2) Monthly spend soft cap: $10,000. Any forecasted exceed must be escalated 7 days prior.
3) Invoicing cadence: consolidated weekly invoices; each invoice must include line-level usage and reference NW-2028-045.
4) Controls: vendor W-9, signed temporary agreement (see template), evidence of services delivered (simple PR/usage export).
5) Audit: Redwood will retain all invoices/evidence for 12 months and provide on request.

Please create a Proc ticket (PROC-712) to capture the approval and attach the signed temporary agreement. Once the signed agreement is in the shared Drive link below, Finance can map accounts and enable billing without a PO for the window.

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-712
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-onboarding-docs

--
Karthik Iyer

Hi Melissa — thanks for the quick turnaround on the forms. Per Procurement (Karthik) and Finance review: Redwood will accept invoices without a PO for the NimbleWorks pilot under the temporary authorization terms outlined below.

Summary of approved terms (final):
- Authorization window: 90 days from first invoice
- Monthly cap: $10,000 (aggregate)
- Invoicing: weekly consolidated invoices; include NW-2028-045 and project code
- Required docs: completed onboarding form, W-9 (we have both), and signed temporary no-PO agreement (attached)
- Finance will run a weekly review during the pilot and reserves the right to require a PO at any time with 7 days notice

Next steps for NimbleWorks:
1) Sign the attached temporary-no-po-agreement.docx and return to onboarding@redwood.ai
2) Confirm first invoice date (proposed April 22)
3) Set up invoice delivery to invoices@redwood.ai with the weekly consolidation header

Attachments: approved-onboarding.pdf (PDF), temporary-no-po-agreement.docx (DOCX)

Welcome aboard — excited to get the pilot running.

Best,
